front_blocks.md: Define **communication**.

back_blocks.md: **Communication** is the process by which **information is transferred** from one person or group (the **sender**) to another (the **receiver**).

cards.front_md: Define **communication**.
cards.back_md: **Communication** is the process by which **information is transferred** from one person or group (the **sender**) to another (the **receiver**).

front_blocks.md: What is the difference between internal and external communication?

back_blocks.md: **Internal** communication is between people **inside** a business; **external** communication is with people or organisations **outside** it.

cards.front_md: What is the difference between internal and external communication?
cards.back_md: **Internal** communication is between people **inside** a business; **external** communication is with people or organisations **outside** it.

front_blocks.md: What are the three main methods of communication?

back_blocks.md: **Verbal**, **non-verbal**, and **written** communication.

cards.front_md: What are the three main methods of communication?
cards.back_md: **Verbal**, **non-verbal**, and **written** communication.

front_blocks.md: Give one benefit of verbal communication.

back_blocks.md: Information is transferred **quickly**, and **immediate feedback** allows **two-way communication**.

cards.front_md: Give one benefit of verbal communication.
cards.back_md: Information is transferred **quickly**, and **immediate feedback** allows **two-way communication**.

front_blocks.md: Give one benefit of written communication.

back_blocks.md: It provides **hard evidence** of the message, suits **detailed** information, and can be **copied to many people**.

cards.front_md: Give one benefit of written communication.
cards.back_md: It provides **hard evidence** of the message, suits **detailed** information, and can be **copied to many people**.

back_blocks.md: It connects people in **different locations**, **reduces travel costs**, and meetings can be set up quickly.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Instant messaging apps like WhatsApp or Slack allow fast, real-time communication.

back_blocks.md: **True.**
**Instant messaging** enables **fast, real-time** communication, ideal for brief or urgent messages.

back_blocks.md: Text-based communication **lacks non-verbal cues**, increasing the chance of **miscommunication**.

front_blocks.md: Define **effective communication**.

back_blocks.md: **Effective communication** is when a message is **received, understood and acted upon** in the way intended.

cards.front_md: Define **effective communication**.
cards.back_md: **Effective communication** is when a message is **received, understood and acted upon** in the way intended.

front_blocks.md: What should effective communication be?

back_blocks.md: **Clear and unambiguous**, **appropriate** to the context, sent to the **correct receiver**, and **timely** with the right amount of detail.

cards.front_md: What should effective communication be?
cards.back_md: **Clear and unambiguous**, **appropriate** to the context, sent to the **correct receiver**, and **timely** with the right amount of detail.

front_blocks.md: Give two benefits of effective communication for a business.

back_blocks.md: **Higher motivation**, improved **efficiency**, more **innovation**, a positive **culture**, **lower costs**, and greater **customer satisfaction**.

cards.front_md: Give two benefits of effective communication for a business.
cards.back_md: **Higher motivation**, improved **efficiency**, more **innovation**, a positive **culture**, **lower costs**, and greater **customer satisfaction**.
